variants.name: 700 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Mixture with vegetables for (dwarf) rabbits
  • Grain-free formula with high fibre content for healthy teeth
  • Naturally varied mixture full of herbs and grasses like timothy hay, with tasty vegetables such as peas, carrots and parsnip
  • Rich in vegetables full of vitamins and minerals
  • Tasty mixture with extruded morsels for optimal intake and digestion, no pressed pellets. No artificial colours, flavours or preservatives
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin (timothy, grasses and herbs 20%), vegetables (peas 9.5%, carrots 5%, parsnip 2.5%), fruit, seeds, vegetable protein extracts, minerals, FOS, MOS, algae, yucca.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 14.5%, crude fat 3%, crude fibre 15%, crude ash 7.5%, calcium 0.75%, phosphorus 0.58%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 10680 IU, vitamin D3 1280 IU, vitamin E 85 mg, vitamin C 28 mg, iron 107 mg, iodine 2 mg, copper 11 mg, manganese 80 mg, zinc 75 mg, selenium 0.2 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: An average daily portion of 50–100 g is recommended, depending on your rabbit's size and breed. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature Timothy Hay and make sure hay is always available. Refresh drinking water daily. For extra variety, combine with Nature Snacks. Tip for picky eaters: only refill the bowl when it is empty, so every meal stays balanced. Not for food-producing animals.
